heading:
Projects that moved
the district forward

items.title: Multipurpose National Identity Card (MNIC) Pilot
items.description: Comprehensive biometric data collection, photography, fingerprinting, data entry, and correction for Tiruvadanai Taluk. Over 70% of operators deployed were differently-abled persons trained by our institution — a national pilot milestone.

items.title: Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan Computer Education
items.description: Delivered hands-on computer education to more than 2,000 rural students of Classes 6, 7, and 8 across the Bogalur educational block — bringing digital literacy to underserved rural communities.

items.title: Election Photo Identity Card (EPIC) Outsourcing
items.description: Supplied specialized data entry manpower for electoral roll preparation and voter ID card generation across two districts — a foundational contribution to Tamil Nadu's democratic infrastructure.

items.title: Rural Banking Computerization
items.description: Full-branch migration and historical data entry to convert manual rural banking operations at Indian Bank (Ramanathapuram and Paramakudi branches) and Pandiyan Grama Bank into fully computerized environments.

items.title: Hospital Automation System
items.description: Designed and deployed a complete clinical management system handling departmental accounting and electronic patient records — one of the earliest hospital automation implementations in the district.

items.client: Joint Director of Agriculture / CMFRI Mandapam
items.title: Long-term Government AMC & Hardware Supply
items.description: Ongoing Annual Maintenance Contract for computers, printers, and UPS systems at the Joint Director of Agriculture since 1998, including 5 NeGPA data entry operators. CMFRI Mandapam Camp AMC since 2004. Hardware supplier for the District Collector's office.

items.title: SSA Household Survey & Minor Irrigation Census
items.description: Large-scale household survey data entry for the SSA programme, prioritizing deployment of economically backward and differently-abled operators. Parallel continuous data entry and validation for the Minor Irrigation Census from year one to date.
